beverage_legal_status: **Unresolved and source-specific.** Italian Article4 decision published13Mar2026 calls ≥98% material made by non-GM *E.coli* strainB fermentation novel, despite comparable identity/purity to tea-derived substance. Taiyo NF2024-15277 requests supplement-only authorisation. Tea infusion history does not establish isolated amino-acid use.
claims_status: No applicable authorised calm, focus, energy or social-ease claim established. Molecular equivalence does not create claims permission.
remaining_gate_sources: Obtain exact manufacturing route and lawful ordinary-food basis; tea-derived, enzymatically made, chemically synthesised and fermented materials must not be treated as one regulatory entry. Do not infer the decision makes every theanine source novel. [EU08,EU09]

beverage_legal_status: Familiar occurrence in cocoa is distinct from isolated addition. Regulation2018/1482 records flavouring use FL16.032, including100mg/kg in category14.1 nonalcoholic beverages. This is a **flavouring-use condition**, not automatic functional-use clearance or a safe-dose recommendation.
claims_status: No authorised alertness/lasting-energy claim established. Caffeine-free compositional wording would not establish stimulant-free or absence of sleep/cardiovascular effects.
remaining_gate_sources: Verify current flavouring annex and legal route for intended physiological use; cocoa extracts also require caffeine testing and composition matching. [EU11]

beverage_legal_status: NF2022-9030 applicant expressly identifies it as novel, chemically synthesised, ≥97%, with proposed functional-drink and supplement uses. **No applicable beverage authorisation established** in current reviewed Union-list material.
claims_status: Not an authorised caffeine-replacement health claim. Applicant's caffeine safety analogy is not EFSA conclusion.
remaining_gate_sources: Wait for applicable authorisation or establish a different lawful exact-material basis; do not import proposed caffeine-like limits into a formula. [EU03,EU10]

beverage_legal_status: No exact supplier process/category clearance established in this targeted search. Amino-acid occurrence in protein and availability of supplements are not proof of the free-amino-acid RTD route.
remaining_gate_sources: Food history, process/purity, national other-substances rules and exposure assessment; no inferred safe daily ceiling. [EU01–EU05]

beverage_legal_status: EC Article4 index17Jul2023 records not-novel; micronised monohydrate20Aug2025 also not-novel. This does not transfer to creatine malate/alpha-ketoglutarate (recorded novel) or every process.
claims_status: **Regulation2026/1118 refuses creatine improved-cognitive-function claim.** Authorised creatine claims concern specified exercise contexts, not alertness.
remaining_gate_sources: Identity/process and acidic RTD stability; keep cognition claims out. [EU02,EU12,EU13]

beverage_legal_status: Established energy-drink context is documented by EFSA, but final ingredient purity/process/category and exposure still require a dossier. No novel authorisation should be invented as the route for conventional taurine.
claims_status: No applicable authorised stimulation/energy/focus claim established; energy-drink familiarity does not show independent stimulant effect.
remaining_gate_sources: Exact source/purity and multiple-serving combined exposures. EFSA2009 assessment is exposure-specific, not unlimited safety. [EU23]

beverage_legal_status: Exact ordinary-beverage route **unresolved**. EMA traditional-medicine monograph is not food permission. Standardisation and extract solvent matter.
claims_status: Botanical/on-hold status is conditional; no authorised acute anti-fatigue/focus or social-ease claim established.
remaining_gate_sources: Pre1997 food category evidence or applicable permission; exact transition dossier; interactions and tolerability. [EU15–EU17,EU26]

beverage_legal_status: Exact ordinary-beverage route unresolved. Species, red/white processing and extraction matter; do not pool American/Siberian “ginseng”.
claims_status: EMA traditional-use conclusion for medicinal fatigue/weakness does not validate a food claim or robust acute effect. Botanical claim transition requires exact assessment.
remaining_gate_sources: Food-use history and preparation; clinically meaningful efficacy; medication review. [EU15–EU17,EU27]

beverage_legal_status: **High-concern/unresolved** for casual multican use. National approaches differ; no blanket EU permission established. Root-only is not automatically interchangeable with root+leaf.
claims_status: Stress/calm/sleep on-hold wording is not unconditional permission; naturalness does not solve safety.
remaining_gate_sources: BfR2024 cannot derive safe intake; liver/endocrine concerns and vulnerable groups argue against launch shortlist pending toxicological/legal review. [EU24]

beverage_legal_status: Culinary/tea use makes a conventional food route plausible, but concentrated/standardised trial extracts need their own history/process/category match. **No final extract cleared.**
claims_status: Sensory lemon-balm description is distinct from “reduces stress” or “calms”; botanical transition unresolved.
remaining_gate_sources: Match botanical preparation to trial and food route; assess drowsiness and additive sedative effects. [EU15–EU17,EU28]

beverage_legal_status: Spice history does not clear every enriched branded extract, petal material or isolated constituent. Exact extract route unresolved.
claims_status: C-386/23 itself concerned saffron/melon mood/stress claims. Do not interpret culinary status as psychological claim permission.
remaining_gate_sources: Stigma identity, adulteration, extraction, markers, daily exposure, transition basis. [EU15,EU16]

beverage_legal_status: **Unresolved and process-specific.** Bloomage application describes ≥98% GABA fermented by *Lentilactobacillus hilgardii* HX12-16 as novel and seeks supplement use. Food occurrence is not permission for purified fermentation GABA in soda.
remaining_gate_sources: Exact strain/manufacturing route, lawful ordinary-drink use and chronic multican safety. Do not transfer application safety assertions to other GABA materials. [EU25]

beverage_legal_status: Specified aqueous powder extracts were determined **not novel** by Czech MZe, published10Sep2026; food and supplement use included. Defined workflow: grinding, water extraction, membrane/TFF filtration, freeze-drying; no significant compositional/structural change. The index also has a28Feb2025 Finnish ultrasound-extract decision. **Dehydrated mycelium is recorded novel.**
claims_status: No applicable authorised cognition/focus/calm claim established. Non-novel does not mean effective or safe at any dose.
remaining_gate_sources: Confirm supplied material actually matches fruiting-body/process decision and science; do not substitute erinacine-enriched mycelium. [EU02,EU18]

beverage_legal_status: Conventional permitted salts may be used under fortification rules, subject to exact current AnnexII. **Magnesium L-threonate** has a distinct novel-food supplement permission; not a general soda ingredient route.
claims_status: Eligible products can use exact claims for normal energy-yielding metabolism, reduced tiredness/fatigue, normal psychological function, nervous-system function and electrolyte balance. None means an immediate calm or energy boost.
remaining_gate_sources: Salt, elemental amount, shelf-life retention and cumulative added-Mg exposure; renal-risk and medicine interaction review. [EU07,EU19,EU21,EU29]

beverage_legal_status: Only allowed vitamins/source forms for ordinary-food fortification, with any additional novel-food conditions respected. “B complex” is not one chemical or one efficacy finding.
claims_status: B5 normal mental performance; B2/B3/B5/B6/B12 reduced tiredness/fatigue and specified energy metabolism; B1/B6/B12 and others have specific nervous/psychological claims. Folic acid is not a general energy-metabolism claim.
remaining_gate_sources: Match exact nutrient/claim; formulation and shelf-life assays; multi-SKU B6 exposure; distinguish nicotinic acid from nicotinamide safety. [EU07,EU19–EU21]

beverage_legal_status: Conventional glucose/sucrose and permitted common carbohydrates have plausible ordinary-food routes; unusual engineered carbohydrates can have separate conditions.
claims_status: Calories are energy provision, not guaranteed alertness. Special sports carbohydrate/electrolyte or recovery claims have exact exercise and composition conditions; they do not authorise a generic office-energy soda promise.
remaining_gate_sources: Sugars/nutrition declarations, glycaemic and sensory implications, dental exposure and actual use occasion. [EU07,EU30]
